dbpm:text_selections.dbpm:selection: Before release, the payment workflow update must undergo validation across multiple aspects of the system.Validation activities are carried out by different roles:- The QA team validates functional correctness of payment processing and retry behavior- The product owner verifies that user-facing behavior aligns with business expectations- The operations team confirms deployment readiness and system stabilityThese validation activities may be performed independently but must all be completed before proceeding.4. Validation ScopeValidation focuses on core transaction flows and typical variations observed during normal operation.Detailed coverage of environment-specific variations and rare edge cases may be handled separately.
